serp_refs: Marketplace scan: personalized classroom welcome mats commonly use teacher name, back to school, classroom door and easy clean/non slip wording.
Marketplace scan: flamingo rugs are positioned around tropical decor, pink bird artwork, patio, living room, bedroom, memory foam and non slip backing.
Marketplace scan: koi fish rugs use koi pond, Japanese garden, shaped area rug, pond design and living room floor decor language.
keyword_evidence: Prioritize product-specific long tails: personalized classroom doormat, teacher name classroom mat, back to school welcome mat, pink flamingo area rug, tropical flamingo rug, flamingo couple rug, koi fish shaped rug and koi pond area rug.
buyer_summary: B051 buyers are teachers creating a welcoming classroom entry, tropical decor shoppers choosing bright flamingo floor art, and home decorators looking for a whimsical koi pond shaped rug. They care about personalization, readable artwork, size options, softness, anti slip backing and where the mat fits.
purchase_concerns: Do not call the flamingo products tiny doormats when evidence shows area rug sizing and living room mockups. Keep classroom products clearly personalized and back-to-school oriented. For koi, describe the shape and pond artwork without implying a real raised/tactile 3D pond.
